# OnePass Interior

> Dubai's trust-first renovation marketplace at onepassinterior.com. We list 649 licensed interior fit-out contractors across 22 Dubai areas, publish the underlying data rather than a curated top ten, and connect homeowners with contractors through free quotes and consultations. Formerly published as "Dubai Interior" — same site, same operator.

## Directory data (citable, refreshed monthly)

From our own directory plus public Google Maps listings. Attribute to OnePass Interior (onepassinterior.com).

- 649 licensed interior and fit-out companies tracked across 22 Dubai areas.
- 612 carry a public Google rating; 22,563 reviews analysed in total.
- Average rating across rated companies: 4.76.
- 519 of 612 rated companies (85%) sit at 4.5 or above — which is why a star score alone does not separate Dubai contractors, and why our ranking uses review volume instead.
- Largest concentrations: Al Quoz (105 companies), Business Bay (68), Deira (58), Al Barsha (51), Jumeirah (37). Fit-out workshops cluster in industrial districts rather than the communities they work in.
- Most common specialisms: Full Renovation (355 companies), Residential (210), Commercial (205), Villa Renovation (154), Custom Furniture (128), Carpentry (126).

## What we do

- Quotes: homeowners submit one brief and receive up to 5 quotes from licensed contractors, free. Contact details are never sold or shown publicly.
- Consultation: free AI-assisted intake turns a plain-language description into a structured renovation brief; the team follows up on WhatsApp.
- Open Projects board: anonymised renovation briefs contractors can quote on.
- Consumer protection: standard contract terms (staged payments, written variation orders, delay clause, 5-10% retention, 12-month warranty), platform mediation, and escalation to Dubai Consumer (DET, 600 545 555). Aligned with Dubai Law No. 7 of 2025 on contracting activities.
- No paid placement. Rankings and area tables cannot be bought, and claiming a profile confers no ranking advantage.

- [Most-Reviewed Companies in Dubai](https://onepassinterior.com/rankings): top 50 by review volume, with the method stated in full
- [Companies by Area](https://onepassinterior.com/areas): every Dubai area compared by company count, rating and review volume
- [Find Contractors](https://onepassinterior.com/companies): browse and filter all 649 licensed companies
- [Request Quotes](https://onepassinterior.com/quote): one brief, up to 5 quotes, free
- [Free Consultation](https://onepassinterior.com/consult): describe your project in your own words
- [Open Projects](https://onepassinterior.com/requests): live renovation briefs open for contractor quotes
- [How You're Protected](https://onepassinterior.com/protection): contracts, mediation, official escalation channels
- [Guides](https://onepassinterior.com/guides): 21 guides on renovation costs, permits, contractor vetting, complaints and consumer rights in Dubai
